name: Saleucami
description: Saleucami, a name that translated into "oasis," was a planet located in the Saleucami system, within the Suolriep sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, its inhabitants wished to stay out of the conflict, though war would eventually reach the backwater planet. Although Republic forces were able to drive the Separatists from Saleucami, it became the site of an invasion and one of the final battles of the war. Jedi Master Stass Allie was killed on her BARC speeder bike by Clone Marshal Commander Neyo at the start of the Great Jedi Purge.
